description: The UNIVERSAL repetition-free route as its own modular seed (loaded only by the read-speech agent, so the song loop never carries it). One more CapabilityAxis the SAME investigation loop predicts: predict-onset-UNIVERSAL -- recall the nearest cadence arc in a HELD LIBRARY banked from OTHER speakers (cross-speaker, speaker-independent on z-normalised contours). Repetition-free by construction (the test speaker is not in the library). The operator attaches to the existing onset_prediction microtheory by cross-ref, so the agent that already operates_in it picks this axis alongside beat/cadence/dynamics with ZERO new wiring; the library is the world executor's mechanical bank (no decision). On a held-out read speaker the universal axis should SATURATE (the library reads a speaker it never banked) -- the agent's loop discovers a universal cadence transfers, not just the stream's own dynamics.

attrs.name: cadence_universal
attrs.comment: the universal cadence: k-NN recall over a HELD library of OTHER speakers' arcs -- reads a held-out speaker, repetition-free and speaker-independent
